subject: prd/argus-boundary-enforcement
statement: Where a supported agent CLI exposes a pre-write hook surface, the write hook shall be wired to it such that a denial fails closed on that CLI.
rationale: cross-CLI fail-closed enforcement (AP-25 vendor-neutral, per-CLI adapters)
fit_criterion: for each supported CLI, a protected-path write attempt is denied fail-closed (a per-CLI adapter test); a CLI whose hook cannot fail closed is documented with the gate/CI backstop as its guarantee
